reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. The reply confirms the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 25 November. She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.

I haven't saved the date anywhere, and I couldn't compare it with any earlier date on record. The workspace's knowledge base (gbrain) refused my search because its access token isn't tied to a member. I told Ilse I hadn't been able to check the date against it. The #north-team history I can see has nothing else about Brackenwater.

To fix gbrain access, someone has to rescope the token on the gbrain server. Either bind it to a single member, or list the members it can act for and name that member on each call. The error message gives the command for that: `gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <MEMBER>`. I didn't change the access setup.
